title: Scalar first-order bound √g ≤ 1 + tD + ε|t| from an exponential bound
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, A ≥ 0 and ε > 0. Then there exist real numbers η and δ with 0 < η ≤ 1 and δ > 0 with the following property. For all real t, D, g with |t| < δ, |D| ≤ nA and g ≤ exp(2tD + 2nη|t| + n(A + 1)²t²), one has √g ≤ 1 + tD + ε|t|. Here √ is the real square root (Real.sqrt, which is 0 on negative numbers).
